signature.name: Claim traceability
signature.description: Every factual claim in the demo README traces to a file, function, CLI argument, test or the generated report in demo-repo, and SKILL.md forces a claim-to-source verification step rather than just asking for accuracy.

group-a.signature_why: All ~20 sampled claims check out against run.py and report.html (subcommands, CSV columns, analysis.json path, empty-workspace precondition, tag names); pitch counts (7 subcommands, 17 flags, 18 files) are exact; ledger lint re-ran 44/44 and selftest 77/77 with 18/18 seeded lies caught.
group-a.loved: It states who produces what: 'The tool measures and checks; it does not run a model', and the sample analysis is named as a prepared file, not output.
group-a.docked: Copy is correct but dry, with no reason to care beyond the opener; the second crop has a ragged right edge, and both images are light-only.

group-b.signature_why: Commands and the reel's three verbatim strings (discovery.md line, verification.json ok:true, report tag) all trace, and verify.mjs re-ran 101/0; but most body text is lifted from the old README, 'Who it fits' never names a reader, and a trailing 'were not run (unverified)' process note leaks into the page.
group-b.loved: The reel is data-bound: every string in the input, check and output cards exists in the repo, with its file path shown.
group-b.docked: The pitch claims a 'what-and-who sentence' the README doesn't have, the adversary read was a self-read, and selftest is INCOMPLETE without Playwright.

group-c.signature_why: Its hook is the most code-faithful sentence on the panel: 'Quote verified' is described exactly as normalize() and verify() at run.py:140-161 implement it, including what it does not check (speaker, length, context), and whisper-cli is taken from the code over the docs; one overstatement, 'verification.json per call' (it is only written where analysis.json exists).
group-c.loved: Saying 'The demo has no failing quote, so this shows only the passing case' under the screenshot.
group-c.docked: The transcript code block overflows at GitHub width, the inferred audience line is thin, a 'How this README was checked' details block leaks process into a shippable README, and the cold run was not repeated after fixes.
